Chew 2 gummies a day, after a meal, 1–2 hours before bed.
Use daily for at least 30 days. For adults 18+ only.
Not to exceed the recommended daily usage.
Not to be used as a substitute for a varied diet.
Store out of reach of children.
Excess magnesium may cause loose stools.
Consult a doctor before use if pregnant, breastfeeding, on
medication or with a kidney condition.
